failures.message: names nothing the suite ran at head — `load_policy` refuses a `witness:` block with `PolicyError` in each of seven cases, and the error quotes the text at fault. A constant pattern with no `name` group. One with no `value` group. One that is not a regular expression. A `replace` naming a group its pattern lacks. A `witness_name` with no `name` group. A `witness_body` with no `{name}` in it. A `witness_body` that is not a regular expression once `{name}` is filled in. It loads a block declaring all three fields, and `Policy.witness` reads them back.
